context: Tests whether the agent discovers the repository's PR template at .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and follows it fully, including the HTML comment directives embedded in each section. Agents without skill guidance may skip the template entirely or ignore the comment instructions.

checklist.name: What heading present
checklist.description: The file pr-description.md contains a '## What' section heading

checklist.name: Why heading present
checklist.description: The file pr-description.md contains a '## Why' section heading

checklist.name: Testing heading present
checklist.description: The file pr-description.md contains a '## Testing' section heading

checklist.name: No TL;DR heading
checklist.description: The file pr-description.md does NOT contain 'TL;DR' as a section heading — the template structure replaces the default body format

checklist.name: No Details heading
checklist.description: The file pr-description.md does NOT contain 'Details' as a section heading

checklist.name: Ticket reference in What
checklist.description: The ## What section includes a reference to a ticket or issue number (e.g. 'Closes #47', 'Fixes #47', 'Addresses #47', or similar identifier) — following the HTML comment directive to include the ticket number

checklist.name: Testing specificity
checklist.description: The ## Testing section describes specific steps taken, commands run, or scenarios checked — not merely a statement that testing was done (e.g. 'I ran the tests') — following the HTML comment directive to explain HOW testing was performed

checklist.name: Why explains motivation
checklist.description: The ## Why section explains the reason or motivation for the change (user need, business value, or technical justification) rather than just restating what was implemented
